agent_fault_records.rule: append and fsync enabled at startup; append and fsync reached after the preceding durable operation and before entering the hold

server_fault_records.rule: commit reached after the preceding durable operation and before entering the hold

ordering_observations.mechanism: subscribe before agent start with generated presence-consumer credentials to ks.out.<agent>.presence; decode the broker-delivered envelope and verify its AST-4 signature, while a separate read-only connection polls the server store; fail if active-and-spent is readable before the verified broker delivery

prove the bootstrap credential connects and completes a request before expiry; after S4, use that still-live credential for a fresh correctly signed request and observe the application denial and its audit row while broker protocol trace contains no publish to $SYS.REQ.CLAIMS.*; after expiry, a new connection with the same credential must fail with the broker authorization violation

the harness subscribes to the token reply subject with the bootstrap credential before enrollment; when it receives S6 it decodes and verifies the enrollment-reply signature using the bundle service key, then reads active-and-spent directly from the server store; the agent process must remain running until that authenticated reply and may exit zero only afterward

boundaries.arrival: durable agent reached record plus a complete mode-0600 agent-key artifact whose public halves are captured by the harness
boundaries.recovery: restart reads the same artifact, presents the captured public halves, and converges on one active identity and one spent token

boundaries.arrival: durable agent reached record after receipt of the credential reply
boundaries.recovery: restart uses the pre-S1 key artifact and the recorded JWT, mints no second identity, and converges on one active identity and one spent token

boundaries.arrival: durable agent reached record plus a complete mode-0600 identity artifact bound to the pre-S1 key artifact digest
boundaries.recovery: restart signs permanent presence with the restored AST-4 key and converges without re-enrollment

boundaries.arrival: durable agent reached record and the harness broker subscription has received and independently verified the signed permanent presence
boundaries.recovery: restart repeats permanent proof idempotently and converges on the unchanged identity

boundaries.arrival: durable agent reached record and a direct server-store read observes active-and-spent
boundaries.recovery: restart requests authenticated S6 confirmation and converges without changing the identity

boundaries.arrival: durable server fault.reached audit row and a direct server-store read observes the single active-and-spent commit
boundaries.recovery: server restart confirms the same identity and spent token, creates neither a second identity nor a second activation
